high_risk_changes: Moved native Shell3 command selection into upstream ParsedExecCommand::prepare and retained local help + captured stream semantics.
Preserved native typed/hash-checked writes and executor-managed filesystem policy while adopting upstream no-follow output hardening.
Adapted core Guardian callers to extracted reviewer crate; upstream retains typed/executor-native cwd and write-stdin identity; native regression tests now include original_command.
Adopted upstream environment attachment and per-tool environment lifecycle for all native tools.
Adapted VMX MCP launcher to new Arc process handle and upstream cancellation-safe replacement slot; preserved native VM lifecycle.
Retained service-owned SQLite journal and reclamation while adopting upstream connection split, NFS/log directory improvements, and startup timing.
Implemented QuickJS CodeModeSessionOptions and Server truncation using upstream collector/render source copied with provenance; terminate budgets and result buffer timings retained.
Restored standalone upstream codex-utils-string imports; corrected removed rustls-provider references in runtime-auth tests.
Uploaded-file audio now uses shared decoding-only utility exports independent of live voice capture/transport, following root decision; native voice capture remains feature-gated.

TRUEOS selects service-owned NFS migration adapter; all client-side inspection/migration APIs return explicit Unsupported without creating locks or modifying images. Upstream host NFS migrator remains unchanged.
Native tools consume dispatcher-captured executor attachments rather than re-resolving old snapshots; direct-call argument fallback retained.
VMX stdio discovery reuses upstream probe/late-reply/legacy-retry state instead of disabling modern local discovery.
New upstream legacy-log-directory cleanup uses platform-aware database_exists, preserving service-owned logical database detection without creating absent databases.
